name: add-filepath-to-terminal
description: Send the active editor's file path (with optional selection line hint) to the most recently used terminal, compatible with @-mention CLIs like omp and opencode.

addFilepathToTerminal.mentionPrefix.description: Prefix inserted before the file path. Keep '@' for at-mention CLIs (omp, opencode, Claude Code); set to empty for a bare path.

addFilepathToTerminal.lineHint.description: Append a #L<start> / #L<start>-<end> hint when there is a non-empty selection.

addFilepathToTerminal.lineHintSeparator.description: separated: '@path #L12' (omp-safe: the mention resolves and the hint stays prose). attached: '@path#L12' (opencode-native format).

addFilepathToTerminal.useAbsolutePath.description: Insert the absolute file path instead of the workspace-relative path.

addFilepathToTerminal.createTerminalIfMi.description: Open a new integrated terminal when there is no active terminal.
